messages:
Juno (marketing): Quick thread  need final battlecard + webinar 90s blurb focused on model-agnostic serving: message vs cloud endpoints, LLM APIs, and appliance infra. Keep bullets tiny.
Mark (sales): Field pain: surprise bills, p99 spikes, migration cost. Need 1-2 line rebut bullets and a demo hook.
Tara (product): Keep a simple structure: claim (1 line), why it matters (1 line), demo hook (1 line). Also add one SRE micro-line.
Nikhil (eng): Bench note: internal dialbench shows ~1.9
2.2x lower billed compute on typical dialog flows when KV session caching + continuous batching + kernel selection are active vs a major cloud endpoint. Median latency comparable; p95 varies by region. Mark as "internal lab results".
Juno (marketing): Hero options: "Econo-ops for inference: predictable bills, steady latency" OR "Serve everywhere: same models, predictable serving economics."
Mark (sales): Rebut snippets (short):
 - Obj: "We're on CloudY already."
   Reply: "CloudY is great for prototyping. In prod teams often hit opaque bill spikes and tail latency. Redwood layers routing, caching, and fallbacks so SREs and finance get predictable bills and SLOs."
 - Obj: "Migration is a headache."
   Reply: "Start with our proxy/drop-in API mode and enable routing/caching incrementally; dedicated/private installs available for lift-and-shift."
 - Obj: "We run appliances for control."
   Reply: "We offer Private deployments and unified tooling so you keep control while gaining observability and predictable economics."
Tara (product): SRE micro-line: "Continuous request coalescing, per-session KV prefix reuse, and kernel selection plus model-variant fallbacks reduce repeat compute while preserving median latency."
Nikhil (eng): Tiny routing example for the demo slide (policy + fallbacks):
 {"policy":"sla-first","primary":"llama-70b","fallbacks":["llama-13b-quant"],"kv_cache":true,"batch_target_ms":9}
Juno (marketing): Inbound routing rules (simple): keywords->AE: "SLA|on-prem|private|dedicated|compliance"; keywords->SDR: "trial|signup|api key|embed|free credits"; score>=80->AE,50-79->SDR,<50->mkt drip. Regex sample: /\b(SLA|on-?prem|private|dedicated|compliance)\b/i
asset-bot: Created stub https://internal.redwood/marketing/assets/econo-ops-brief (marketing-edit)
Mark (sales): I'll draft two roleplay lines for the battlecard after Juno posts the one-pager.
Juno (marketing): Awesome. Aim to freeze copy by EOD Monday so design can mock slides. Post edits here.
